description: Search LinkedIn Jobs by keyword and location, or paste ready-made LinkedIn Jobs search URLs. No login or cookies needed.

datePosted.description: Only return jobs posted within this window.
datePosted.title: Date posted

experienceLevel.description: Filter by seniority. Leave empty for all levels.
experienceLevel.title: Experience level

jobType.description: Filter by employment type. Leave empty for all types.
jobType.title: Job type

keywords.description: Job title, skill or company to search for, e.g. "software engineer" or "data analyst".
keywords.title: Keywords

location.description: City, region or country, e.g. "United States", "London, United Kingdom" or "Remote". Leave empty to search worldwide.
location.title: Location

maxItems.description: Stop after collecting this many jobs. Keeps runs fast and cheap while testing.
maxItems.title: Maximum jobs to scrape

proxyConfiguration.description: LinkedIn rate-limits datacenter IPs quickly. Residential proxies are strongly recommended for detail scraping and for runs above ~100 jobs.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

scrapeJobDetails.description: Open every job page for the full description, seniority level, employment type, job function, industries, applicant count and apply link. Turn off for a faster, cheaper title/company/location-only run.
scrapeJobDetails.title: Scrape full job details

sortBy.description: Most relevant first (LinkedIn default) or most recent first.
sortBy.title: Sort results by

startUrls.description: Paste full LinkedIn Jobs search URLs (linkedin.com/jobs/search/...) to scrape exactly those searches. When filled, the keyword/location fields above are ignored.

url.title: URL
url.description: URL of the LinkedIn Jobs search page.

items.description: A LinkedIn Jobs search page to scrape.

startUrls.title: LinkedIn Jobs search URLs (optional)

workType.description: On-site, remote or hybrid. Leave empty for all.
workType.title: Work type
